name: B10-0166/2025 (The Left) – Continuing the unwavering EU support for Ukraine, after three years of Russia’s war of aggression
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on continuing the unwavering EU support for Ukraine, after three years of Russia’s war of aggression
part_text:
This is a resolution from a political group in the European Parliament. It does not change any law. It sets out what the group wants the EU to do about the war in Ukraine: push for an immediate ceasefire and peace talks, include Russia and Ukraine in negotiations, oppose Ukraine joining NATO, refuse to send European troops, and cancel Ukraine's foreign debt. It also criticises the EU's rearmament plan and its close alignment with the United States and NATO.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. It is a set of demands and opinions, not a law.
- **Who it affects:** EU governments, Ukraine, Russia, and NATO, if the demands were followed.
- **What happens next:** It is sent to EU institutions and governments for consideration; no binding action follows.
